title: Celebrate Tab Label Foreground
description: Panel/chrome tab labels nested under a wrapper div are missed by CelebrateContent direct-child span selector, so celebrate paints icons but not label text.
summary: Stamped data-slot=inline-label on panel/mode-dock/pane/button/action label spans. CelebrateContent now paints inline-label (and tree-label) with background-clip:text and transparent text-fill so nested chrome tab labels get the spinning conic like icons. Proof script and CSS contract test updated.
